summary: Trace runtime.py outward; adopt boundary/trace/replay ideas, not the original BrainRuntime core.

paths.name: execution_gate_path
paths.finding: ExecutionGate and ExecutionState are conceptually useful; recall runtime bridge is risky because it applies influence packets and old policy enables recall execution.
paths.recommendation: Defer active use; translate into future dormant authorization packet/AEM gate scaffold.

paths.name: observation_episodic_replay_path
paths.finding: Best adoption path. Read-only hooks, immutable events, append-only trace, passive tracker, and offline replay align with current V1.4D feedback/replay direction.
paths.recommendation: Use as source material for Runtime V1.4E sleep/replay consolidation design.

paths.name: attention_working_memory_snapshot_path
paths.finding: Read-only snapshot hooks are useful report-only diagnostics but should not change current activation/attention behavior.
paths.recommendation: Adapt later as answer-trace enrichment or diagnostics.

paths.name: hypothesis_path
paths.finding: Offline hypothesis trace/runner pattern is useful; runtime routing influence should remain deferred.
paths.recommendation: Adapt as report-only hypothesis arbitration later, not as runtime routing.

opinion: Original DELTA can save time if used as source material. Do not copy engine/runtime.py. The best reusable material is the episodic trace/replay path and offline hypothesis trace tooling.
